content:
maria: Quick escalation — SBMarket install hit a hard blocker during validation. Customer can't pull marketplace image from our registry over their privatelink path. 403s from their env, go-live scheduled tomorrow morning. Need arch + SI delivery eyes now.

alex: Which image / registry URL? Can we repro from a test VPC that uses privatelink?

maria: Registry URL: https://marketplace.redwood.internal/registry/sbmarket/enterprise:2026-03-20. Customer sees 403 with X-Privatelink-Endpoint mismatch header. Tried toggling TLS passthrough on their gateway, no luck.

samir: Pinged infra to check routing. Can you paste the raw curl output?

maria: Here is what their engineer shared:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" "https://marketplace.redwood.internal/registry/sbmarket/enterprise:2026-03-20"
* Connected to marketplace.redwood.internal (10.10.0.5) port 443 (#0)
> GET /registry/sbmarket/enterprise:2026-03-20 HTTP/1.1
> Host: marketplace.redwood.internal
> Authorization: Bearer <token>
< HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
< Content-Type: application/json
< X-Privatelink-Endpoint: arn:aws:privatelink:us-west-2:123456789012:endpoint/incorrect-vpc
{
  "error": "privatelink_endpoint_mismatch",
  "message": "endpoint configured for account does not match request source"
}
```

jamie: Hmm — that header shows the request is hitting a different PL endpoint than the one associated with the customer's marketplace subscription. Two possibilities: 1) their gateway NAT is translating source IPs to a different VPC (we've seen this with transit gateway routing), or 2) our marketplace routing table has two endpoints and auth is bound to the wrong endpoint ARN.

alex: If it's routing on their side we can offer a workaround: create a temporary signed pull URL for the image (one-off) so their install can continue while we debug. That avoids reconfiguring privatelink pre-go-live. Any objections?

samir: I can generate a pre-signed artifact link but need legal + billing sign-off (this bypasses normal marketplace metering). Who's owning the contract for SBMarket?

maria: Sales owns it (cc @sales), but they're not in this channel. Customer explicitly asked for go/no-go. We need a fast short-term fix and a durable root cause.

jamie: Quick architecture check we should run now: 1) confirm the PL endpoint ARN associated with the customer's subscription in our database; 2) check marketplace routing table for overlapping endpoints; 3) validate the customer's TGW/NAT behavior (are they SNATing to a shared egress?). Samir — can you pull the ARN?

samir: Working on it. Found subscription record: privileged_endpoint_arn=arn:aws:privatelink:us-west-2:123456789012:endpoint/cust-sbmarket-9876. Marketplace routing entries: endpoint/cust-sbmarket-9876 -> 10.10.0.5, endpoint/shared-marketplace-1111 -> 10.10.0.6. Looks fine, but the request hit endpoint/incorrect-vpc (arn:.../incorrect-vpc). That ARN isn't in the DB.

alex: That suggests request spoofing: their gateway might be translating source metadata so our edge believes it's coming from a different account, or there's a stale route advertisement from a partner VPC. Ops should look for BGP/route leaks.

maria: Customer reports they've recently added a partner transit setup to centralize egress. Could be SNAT.

samir: Immediate action plan I recommend: 1) I will create a time-limited pre-signed pull URL for the image and share it privately with the customer (valid 24h). 2) Ops team to check edge routing and BGP for route leaks. 3) Schedule an architecture review with customer + our network SME to confirm transit behavior and long-term fix.

jamie: Agreed. Long-term fix options: (A) bind auth to source IP ranges associated with the customer's egress (fragile), (B) require the customer to present a proxy-header with original endpoint ARN (requires code change), (C) add a marketplace config that allows additional permitted endpoint ARNs for an account. Option C is the most robust.

alex: For the short term we'll do Samir's pre-signed link. Samir — add a note to the contract ticket so billing can retroactively account for the pull. Also mark as "delivery-workaround" so we can audit.

samir: Done — generated link and DM'd customer. Link expires in 24h. Added note to ticket #INC-4521 and tagged billing.

maria: Customer confirmed they could pull image with the presigned link and resumed install. Go-live still on for tomorrow but we need the architecture review first thing in the AM.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-4521 - marketplace-privatelink-auth-mismatch. Pager duty: network-oncall.

jamie: I'll lead the architecture review with the customer. Maria — can you loop in their network lead and propose times? Prefer within next 12h.

maria: Looping in now and sending calendar invite for 09:00 PST. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
